mapper.sql: KPIID, KPICODE, KPINAME, KPICATEGORY, KPITYPE, CALCULATIONFORMULA, DATASOURCE, UNIT, TARGETVALUE, WARNINGTHRESHOLD, CRITICALTHRESHOLD, CURRENTVALUE, PREVIOUSVALUE, CHANGEPERCENTAGE, TREND, CALCULATIONDATE, CALCULATIONFREQUENCY, KPISTATUS, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPICATEGORY = #{kpiCategory} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY KPINAME
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPITYPE = #{kpiType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY KPINAME
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPISTATUS = #{kpiStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY KPINAME
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPISTATUS = 'WARNING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CALCULATIONDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPISTATUS = 'CRITICAL' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CALCULATIONDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPISTATUS = 'NORMAL' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CALCULATIONDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE KPISTATUS != 'INACTIVE' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY KPINAME

SELECT KPITYPE AS kpiType, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY KPITYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT KPISTATUS AS kpiStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY KPISTATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT KPICATEGORY AS kpiCategory, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY KPICATEGORY ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT TREND AS trend, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND TREND IS NOT NULL), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND TREND IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TREND ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT KPICODE AS kpiCode, KPINAME AS kpiName, CURRENTVALUE AS currentValue, TARGETVALUE AS targetValue, CASE WHEN TARGETVALUE IS NULL OR TARGETVALUE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((CURRENTVALUE / TARGETVALUE * 100), 2) END AS completionRate, CASE WHEN CURRENTVALUE >= TARGETVALUE THEN 'ACHIEVED' WHEN CURRENTVALUE >= TARGETVALUE * 0.8 THEN 'NEAR_TARGET' ELSE 'BELOW_TARGET' END AS achievementStatus FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CURRENTVALUE IS NOT NULL AND TARGETVALUE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY completionRate DESC

SELECT CALCULATIONFREQUENCY AS calculationFrequency, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY CALCULATIONFREQUENCY ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN KPISTATUS = 'WARNING' THEN 1 END) AS warningCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN KPISTATUS = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) AS criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CURRENTVALUE < WARNINGTHRESHOLD THEN 1 END) AS belowWarningCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CURRENTVALUE < CRITICALTHRESHOLD THEN 1 END) AS belowCriticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CURRENTVALUE < TARGETVALUE THEN 1 END) AS belowTargetCount FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND KPISTATUS != 'INACTIVE'

SELECT DATASOURCE AS dataSource, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND DATASOURCE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATASOURCE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CALCULATIONDATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY ORDER BY CALCULATIONDATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND (CALCULATIONDATE IS NULL OR CURRENTVALUE IS NULL) AND KPISTATUS != 'INACTIVE' ORDER BY CREATETIME ASC

SELECT FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ( (CURRENTVALUE IS NOT NULL AND CURRENTVALUE < 0) OR (TARGETVALUE IS NOT NULL AND TARGETVALUE <= 0) OR (WARNINGTHRESHOLD IS NOT NULL AND CRITICALTHRESHOLD IS NOT NULL AND WARNINGTHRESHOLD < CRITICALTHRESHOLD) OR (CHANGEPERCENTAGE IS NOT NULL AND ABS(CHANGEPERCENTAGE) > 1000) ) ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_KPI_INDICATORS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CREATETIME < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{retentionDays}' DAY AND KPISTATUS = 'INACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_KPI_INDICATORS SET PREVIOUSVALUE = NULL, CHANGEPERCENTAGE = NULL WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CALCULATIONDATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY
